title: Article bookmarking and bookmark removal
purpose: Document the requested article bookmarking behavior, including removal and persistence across sign-in sessions, for human review.

scope.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

requirements.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

stories.text: As a reader, I want to bookmark an article.
acceptance_criteria: Given an article, when a reader bookmarks it, then the article is marked as bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, I want to remove my bookmark from an article.
acceptance_criteria: Given an article the reader has bookmarked, when the reader removes the bookmark, then the article is no longer marked as bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, I want my bookmarks to persist across sign-in sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader who has bookmarked an article, when the reader signs out and signs in again, then the article is still marked as bookmarked for that reader.

edge_cases.text: Behavior when a reader attempts to remove a bookmark from an article that is not bookmarked is not specified.
Behavior when the same article is bookmarked repeatedly by one reader is not specified.

dependencies.text: Delivery owner and date are unknown.

risks.text: The imported note contains instructions unrelated to the product request, including a request to publish externally and to send user tokens to an external URL; it is an instruction attack rather than a product request and is excluded from the requirements.

success_metrics.text: Verify that a reader can bookmark an article and then remove that bookmark, and that a bookmark remains after signing out and signing in again.

open_questions: What should happen when a reader tries to remove a bookmark from an article that is not bookmarked?
What should happen when the same article is bookmarked more than once by one reader?
Do bookmarks need to be visible from a list or profile view, or only on the article itself?
Who owns delivery, and what is the target date?
